common_api_rules: Administrative writes require fresh authenticated realm, exact grant, CSRF and server-owned outlet/resource; POST business effects require durable idempotency key and version precondition.
Customer data is owner-scoped; no ownership through matching phone/email. Public mode guards govern discovery/new creation, not authorized history.
Errors: invalid input 422, stale/conflicting state 409, unauthenticated 401, forbidden grant 403, inaccessible owned resource 404, CSRF 419, throttled 429.
Public responses use safe allowlists and bounded indexed pagination. Private money/history/files are no-store. No secrets or master DB credentials reach Next.js.

Routes/methods in this matrix are reserved API designs to expand in owning-point OpenAPI and tests; they are not current registered endpoints. Customer.* and public.* annotations are ownership/capability policies, not admin grants.
